classification.difficultyReason: Complete the supplied product columns and totals, then divide total products by total frequency; the tables, examples and displayed formula explicitly scaffold the method.

content.prompt: Calculate the mean from this frequency table.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}8\times6&=48\\9\times8&=72\\10\times15&=150\\11\times11&=121\\12\times3&=36\\\Sigma f&=6+8+15+11+3=43\\\Sigma xf&=48+72+150+121+36=427\\\bar{x}&=\frac{\Sigma xf}{\Sigma f}\\\bar{x}&=\frac{427}{43}\\\bar{x}&\approx9.93\end{aligned}$$
The mean is rounded to 2 decimal places.

$$\begin{align*}5\times7&=35\\6\times13&=78\\7\times18&=126\\8\times15&=120\\9\times12&=108\\\Sigma f&=7+13+18+15+12\\\Sigma f&=65\\\Sigma xf&=35+78+126+120+108\\\Sigma xf&=467\\\bar{x}&=\frac{\Sigma xf}{\Sigma f}\\\bar{x}&=\frac{467}{65}\\\bar{x}&\approx7.18\end{align*}$$
The exact mean is $\frac{467}{65}$; $7.18$ is its value to 2 decimal places.
